claims.title: RoadC interpreter
claims.claim: Executable language behavior, including functions, closures, control flow, collections, records and CLI failures.
claims.limits: Core profile: 49 modules, 765 tests; generated and cross-repository integration profiles excluded.

claims.title: RoadC native compilation
claims.claim: Six native-compiler tests passed within the core profile.
claims.limits: Subset of the 765 core tests; not six additional tests.

claims.title: Offline quantum simulation
claims.claim: 120 quantum-related tests passed across seven modules, including the CLI, statevector simulation, observables, measurements, energy, gradients and optimization.
claims.limits: Subset of the 765 core tests; simulation on classical hardware.

claims.title: Scoped local system workflow
claims.claim: Create records, connect a project and task, deny an unauthorized read, grant access, execute a read, verify content/receipt hashes and recover records after restart.
claims.limits: Six startup tests using real CLI and loopback HTTP processes.

claims.title: Local service lifecycle
claims.claim: Local start/status/restart/stop, concurrent lifecycle behavior, control-file boundaries and health reporting passed 16 tests.
claims.limits: Assistant Linux runner; no macOS login or reboot qualification.

claims.title: Permission-gated object reads
claims.claim: 21 object-read checks passed, including denied reads, invalid references, unavailable objects and evidence-write failures.
claims.limits: Local operator CLI; identity selection alone is not user authentication.

claims.title: Grant-store boundaries
claims.claim: Five grant-store tests passed at the pinned system revision.
claims.limits: No general authorization or adversarial process-isolation certification.

claims.title: Local API file boundaries
claims.claim: Eight API object-security tests passed for malformed, linked and special-file records.
claims.limits: Loopback API scope; not production authentication.

claims.title: Web request ordering
claims.claim: Ten system web tests passed, including stale-result and unavailable-state behavior.
claims.limits: Node tests; not a real-browser visual qualification.

claims.title: RoadOS workspace continuity
claims.claim: 77 workspace tests passed for context following, pinning, drafts, document/session gates, four local Computer identities and collaboration.
claims.limits: Includes DOM/VM doubles and two real local HTTP Host tests; no Chromium or fleet qualification.

claims.title: Signed core authority and evidence
claims.claim: 44 selected identity, grant, denial, execution, verification, tamper, restart, revocation, export, continuity, owner-control and canonical/fixture tests passed.
claims.limits: Node 24.19.0 observation; the core declares Node >=26. Broad suite is unqualified.

claims.title: Queued-effect authorization
claims.claim: The queued-effect suite passed inside the selected authority run: current grants/revocations, preview behavior, single release, request scope and signing-key custody are exercised.
claims.limits: Nine tests are included in the 44; standalone queue, not a complete integrated product.

claims.title: Queued-effect defect sensitivity
claims.claim: All 15 specified mutation injections were applied and caught, with zero survivors or unappliable anchors; source hashes matched after restoration.
claims.limits: Bounded mutation set in an isolated source export; not exhaustive defect coverage.

claims.title: Road94 codec conformance
claims.claim: All ten conformance stages passed: 64 Python test methods and eight Node tests, including frame vectors and failure paths.
claims.limits: Bounded codec suite; not all RoadMath tests.

claims.title: Complete typed-triple recovery
claims.claim: An independent enumeration checked rank and coordinate recovery for every one of the 282,752 defined triples.
claims.limits: Finite domain: endpoints 0..93 and retained relation codes 1..32.

claims.title: Exact fixed-width bound
claims.claim: 19 bits are necessary and sufficient for a uniform injective fixed-width encoding of the complete typed-triple domain.
claims.limits: Standard cardinality proof; not a 19-bit transport size or security strength.

claims.title: Unused-rank rejection
claims.claim: Every one of the 241,536 unused 19-bit ranks was independently checked and rejected.
claims.limits: These are enumerated inputs, not independently authored test methods.

claims.title: Smaller connected-chain frames
claims.claim: For the selected 100-edge chain, automatic mode produced 218 bytes versus 299 for forced block mode, saving exactly 81 bytes (81/299, approximately 27.09%).
claims.limits: Same losslessly recovered chain; comparison of two existing modes, with shared 72-byte overhead. No time, cost or energy result.

claims.title: Python/JavaScript interoperability
claims.claim: The codec suite passed 200 bidirectional mixed cases and a separate 202-input selector-byte comparison.
claims.limits: These overlap the eight Node tests; they are not additional test-method counts.

claims.title: Information-loss boundaries
claims.claim: The independent audit exercised residue-only sheet collisions and the modulo-94 sum/difference collision, while full encodings retained recovery.
claims.limits: Standard modular arithmetic; no mathematical novelty asserted.
